BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI/ADD
BRANCH: ECE   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT : EC6203 FIBER OPTICS COMM. SYSTEM

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Write four distinct advantages of fiber optic communication systems. [2]
 (b) Draw the block diagram of a fiber optic communication system and explain the function
of each element in the system.
[3]


Q2 (a) Draw the r.i. profiles of SI and GI fiber and compare their advantages and disadvantages. [2]
 (b) An  optical  fiber  is  required  to  support  only  one  mode  at  a  wavelength  of  1550nm.
Estimate the maximum core radius allowed for the fiber if it has core r.i. of 1.47 and
cladding r.i. of 1.46. What is the maximum acceptance angle of the fiber?
[3]


Q3 (a) Compare the silica glass fibers with halide glass fibers and plastic fibers. [2]
 (b) Explain  with  diagram  the  VAD  method  for fiber preform  fabrication.  Mention  its
advantages.
[3]


Q4 (a) Define beat length of optical fiber and explain how it affects the data rate of fiber optic
communication system.
[2]
 (b) Starting with the wave equation for electric field, develop the condition of bound modes
in SI fiber.
[3]


Q5 (a) Define the numerical aperture of GI fiber. [2]
 (b) The axial refractive index of a GI fiber having a parabolic index profile operating at 1310
nm is n
1
=1.48 and  the cladding refractive index is n
2
=1.47. The core radius of the fiber
is 25 μm. Calculate the number of modes in the fiber. How many modes will be supported
by a corresponding SI fiber at this wavelength?
[3]


Q6 (a) Explain the signal attenuation due to Rayleigh scattering and macrobending in optical
fiber.
[2]
 (b) An  optical  fiber  has  a  loss  of  0.25dB/km  at  1545nm.  If 275μW  of  power  is  initially
launched into the fiber, estimate the output power at a distance of 250km.
[3]
